Name: Vanilla pixel art Belos portrait and matching sprite
Author: GodCucumber69
Description:
It bothered me very much that the sprite of Belos and his portrait did not look alike at all and that they did not fit well with Stardew Valley vanilla, so I took on the task of creating these assets for those who had the same problem as me with the sprite and the portrait.

To use this mod you need to do:-For the portrait: Download Portraiture, create a folder called Belos in the Mod and add the png to the folder, from there follow the Portraiture instructions.-For the sprite: In the assets folder of the Belos Mod, replace the original sprite with the sprite that is included in this Mod.
